author: 3owj
content: Implemented: workspace assembler now walks vault_root (excluding _synthetic/, _generated/, _csnotes/, _synthetic_* dirs) and writes _vault_stems.json to the workspace with lowercased stems+paths of all other vault files. render_session_md gets a new '## Other Vault Files' section listing these files grouped by directory so Claude knows what it can link to. audit.rs: check_links_resolve gains extra: &HashSet<String> param; invariant_suite and check_workspace load _vault_stems.json via load_vault_stems(); audit_vault uses collect_vault_stems() directly against vault_root. New public functions: collect_vault_stems, load_vault_stems. 5 new tests. 366 total, 0 failed.
